children: Welcome to our weekly ChartWatch *LIVE* Webinar series. Hundreds of Aussie investors joined me at lunchtime to learn more about technical analysis by using the ASX stocks they’re interested in as case studies.
But that’s the point of ChartWatch *LIVE* – it’s not up to me to set the agenda – it’s up to you! 🫵
Click the "Watch on YouTube" button in the player above, or go to our YouTube page, to check out our other fantastic technical analysis videos when you're done with this one!

If you attended, I trust that you enjoyed the session and leant plenty about how to think and act like a trend following technical analyst. If you weren't able to make it, or if you haven't registered yet, then I hope you can join me Wednesday, 30 October, at 12:00pm AEDTfor the next instalment. Be sure to bring an open mind about investing plus two of your favourite ASX stocks for me to analyse!
In this week's edition (click links to jump to a segment of the video 📺!)
00:01:05 PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT MODEL Nasdaq Composite, S&P/ASX 200
01:04:35 Announcement: ChartWatch Live is taking a break for Carl's holiday 🏖️
01:06:05 HOW TO GET CARL'S TREND RIBBONS

Learn more about technical analysis and trend following through real case studies on ASX stocks. Australia's premier technical analyst, Carl Capolingua, shares his unique insights on stocks as requested by viewers. Ask about a company in your portfolio or anything related to trading and investing and get Carl's expert opinion.
It’s getting serious in financial markets… Oil prices are soaring, bond yields are nudging levels not seen since immediately before the GFC, commodities – once strong – are beginning to falter…
And the Australian share market is bobbing up and down (mostly down) in a sea of global uncertainty and growing investor fear. What does one do? Where does one turn? We have the answer: ChartWatch!

In this masterclass of sensible investing, Australia’s premier financial markets analyst Carl Capolingua walks you through his unique method for protecting and growing his capital – that anyone (including you!) can follow.

title: How to protect your portfolio in a 'market meltdown' – expert investor sells out and goes on vacation!
